description: On-chain racing game for Binance Agent ID holders on BNB Chain: weekly heats on a 100-step track, free daily moves, Nitro boosts, champion takes a 50%-of-pool prize paid by the project within 24 hours of settlement (recorded on-chain).

game.enterPro: enterPro() - exactly 0.0007 BNB, up to 3 racers per wallet per heat, no Agent ID required, starts at step 5
game.enterRookie: enterRookie() - free (0 BNB), 1 racer per wallet per heat, caller must hold a Binance Agent ID NFT, starts at step 0
game.heats: Weekly, Monday 00:00 UTC to Monday 00:00 UTC. Read currentHeat() on the contract for the live heat id; entries are open (entryOpen() = true).
game.move: move(racerId) - free, once per UTC day per racer, advances 1-6 steps; the draw derives from on-chain block data, verifiable after the fact, not VRF-grade
game.nitro: nitro(racerId, tier) - tier 0: 0.00015 BNB for +2 steps; tier 1: 0.0005 BNB for +7 steps; tier 2: 0.0015 BNB for +20 steps
game.settle: settleHeat(heatId) - permissionless after the heat ends or a racer reaches step 100; champion and the 50%-of-pool prize are recorded on-chain (heats(heatId)); the project pays the prize within 24 hours and flags it via markPrizePaid(heatId)

name: Crown Race

nft.freeMint: 500 cards, Agent ID holders, 1 per wallet, ROOKIE only
nft.name: Crown Racer Cards
nft.paidMint: exactly 0.001 BNB, max 5 per wallet total across both lanes

token.status: planned, not launched; the game currently runs on BNB
